mapper.insert: INSERT INTO attendance_check_ins (shift_id, worker_id, check_in_time, check_in_lat, check_in_lng, late_seconds, early_leave_seconds) VALUES (#{shiftId}, #{workerId}, #{checkInTime}, #{checkInLat}, #{checkInLng}, #{lateSeconds}, #{earlyLeaveSeconds})
mapper.update: UPDATE attendance_check_ins SET early_leave_seconds = #{earlyLeaveSeconds}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM attendance_check_ins WHERE shift_id = #{shiftId} ORDER BY check_in_time ASC
